commit: fix(javascript): read the source type from the .cjs and .mjs file extension

truth.description: babel now parses any options.filepath ending in .cjs as a script that rejects import and export, but textToDoc in multiparser.js spreads the parent file's options into every embedded format, so a markdown template literal in a .cjs file hands that path on to its js code blocks through the markdown embed, and a code block with an import statement no longer parses and is left unformatted.

distractions.why: parseWithOptions now passes sourceType and sets allowImportExportEverywhere on every attempt, so the defaults commented out of parseOptions are never needed.
